name: Keep retained nodes and collect their text leaves in one pass

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: keep_retained_nodes looks every key up three times (all-or-none check, claim, text-leaf collection); fusing the claim and the collection into one pass should cut hashing and the intermediate Vec.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Fuse claim and leaf collection (all-or-none keeps a read-only pre-check), run fast:: tests, alternate old/new binaries four times on dashboard-clock, tree-toggle and table-stream with fast mode on.
reportMarkdown: Within noise on all three scenarios; the 437 fast tests pass. The lookups were cheap Fx hashes of u64 keys, and the profile's keep_retained_nodes self time was the loop over the keys itself, not the extra passes.
decisionMarkdown: Revert: no measurable gain for the added code.
